title: New MCP tools default-allow on restricted surfaces (bbox_embed_partitions vs bbox_embed_status on 'default')
wanted_capability: Surface policy should classify newly added tools deliberately instead of letting unknown tools fall through as allowed on restricted surfaces. Observed during the Phase 2/3 embedding rollout (2026-07-11): on surface 'default', bbox_embed_status is denied ("tool not available on surface 'default'") but the freshly added bbox_embed_partitions (including its prune action) answered without any surface config change, meaning restricted surfaces silently widen every time a tool ships. Want either a default-deny posture for tools not named by the surface's allow set, or a startup/lint check that flags tools missing an explicit surface classification.
fallback_used: Used ?surface=interactive for operator calls; no config change made.
evidence: MCP error on same surface: tool not available on surface 'default': bbox_embed_status
